gates.title: Demand
gates.pass_criteria: At least 8/15 recurring DJ problem reports and 5/15 concrete follow-ups; then pilot retention/payment evidence
gates.scope_note: Evidence may be collected only within separately authorized scope

gates.title: Upload tolerance
gates.pass_criteria: 8/10 selected-crate activation; 95% interrupted recovery; no accepted corruption
gates.scope_note: Evidence may be collected only within separately authorized scope

gates.title: Storage and playback
gates.pass_criteria: Private playback p95 start ≤3s and seek ≤2s on defined profile; acceptable bill
gates.scope_note: Evidence may be collected only within separately authorized scope

gates.title: Rights and license path
gates.evidence_needed: Written use/jurisdiction matrix and component review

gates.scope_note: Evidence may be collected only within separately authorized scope

gates.title: Analysis portability
gates.pass_criteria: Pinned target worker succeeds within approved memory/time/cost and preserves estimate provenance
gates.scope_note: Evidence may be collected only within separately authorized scope

gates.title: Mix quality and reproducibility
gates.pass_criteria: Approved headroom policy, broader blinded listening and same-environment reproducibility
gates.scope_note: Evidence may be collected only within separately authorized scope

gates.title: Security and deletion
gates.pass_criteria: Zero unauthorized access in two-tenant matrix; deletion/restore tombstones verified
gates.scope_note: Evidence may be collected only within separately authorized scope

gates.title: Economics
gates.pass_criteria: Agreed target margin, p95 quota economics and acquisition payback; all costs disclosed
gates.scope_note: Evidence may be collected only within separately authorized scope

gates.title: Operational readiness
gates.pass_criteria: Budget stop, monitoring, recovery and support ownership rehearsed
gates.scope_note: Evidence may be collected only within separately authorized scope

gates.title: Implementation authorization
gates.pass_criteria: Named approved capabilities, provider, fixtures, caps and stop conditions; gates reviewed
gates.scope_note: Full-mix build additionally requires G006; spike authorization is a separate bounded decision
